title: Rosalind and the Bakery
author: Petra Sandoval
blurb: Beatrix Sandoval, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
